verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Navan letting users define recurring schedules for jobs or workflows. The 'scheduled partner integrations' wording only says the Expense API suits integrations that partners schedule on their own side, which is a user-side workaround. 'Policy and approval workflows' are a separate feature, and async job polling covers one-off jobs, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
